 Live Discussion: Indiana Pacers at Brooklyn Nets, 6:00 PM ET
 Nets are looking for their first win of the season…
 by Anthony Puccio Oct 25, 2026, 9:20 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Brooklyn Nets are still searching for their first win of the 2026-27 season, and they’ll have to find it on tired legs.
 Brooklyn nearly erased a 22-point deficit in Cleveland on Saturday, outscoring the Cavaliers 41-29 in the fourth quarter before falling 125-121. The Nets return to Barclays Center on Sunday to face the Indiana Pacers in the second game of a back-to-back.
 Meanwhile, sixth-overall pick Mikel Brown Jr. won’t be active for this one. He’s already on a minutes restriction and it looks like the Nets will keep him out of second night of back-to-backs for the foreseeable future. He rolled his ankle in the preseason.
 Indiana arrives in Brooklyn coming off their own 16-point loss to the Dallas Mavericks.
 Game Info & How to Watch
 Matchup: Brooklyn Nets (0-2) vs. Indiana Pacers (1-1) 
 Time: 6:00 PM ET 
 Location: Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York 
 TV/Streaming: YES Network and DAZN

 Brooklyn Nets 
 Mikel Brown Jr. — OUT 
 Indiana Pacers 
 T.J. McConnell – OUT 
 Johnny Furphy – OUT
